summary: Full backend + frontend test of EditGuil admin back-office (iteration 2). Backend: 26/26 pytest cases pass — covers root, public GET /api/content (all 13 sections), auth login (valid/wrong-pw/unknown-email/no-token/invalid-token/valid-token), /auth/me, PUT /api/content (401 w/o token, 200 + persistence verified via GET, restore), POST /api/contact still public, GET /api/admin/contacts (401 + 200 lists), DELETE /api/admin/contacts/{id} (401 + 200 + 404), POST /api/admin/upload (401 + valid PNG + invalid .exe), idempotent admin seed (3x login). Frontend Playwright: admin-login-form visible, wrong creds → error toast, valid creds → redirect /admin, all 14 tabs visible (13 sections + Messages reçus), hero name_line1 edit + save → success toast → public homepage in fresh tab shows new marker (full e2e content flow works), Messages tab loads, logout clears token and redirects to /admin/login, visiting /admin without token redirects to /admin/login. Image upload tested via backend (frontend ImageInput uses same endpoint).

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid HTML — a <button type='button'> (delete) and an <a> (Répondre) are nested inside the outer accordion <button> (lines 525–556 of AdminDashboard.jsx). React logs hydration error: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>'. Functionality still works (e.stopPropagation), but it's invalid HTML and pollutes the console.

action_items: Refactor AdminDashboard.ContactsList: replace outer <button> wrapping the row with a <div> + onClick (or use a separate small toggle button) so the delete <button> and 'Répondre' <a> aren't nested inside another <button>. Eliminates the React hydration warning at /admin → Messages reçus tab.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py @app.on_event('startup') / 'shutdown' decorators are deprecated in FastAPI ≥0.93 — consider switching to a lifespan context manager.

PUT /api/content accepts an entirely free-form Dict[str, Any]; no schema validation means a malformed admin save could silently corrupt the singleton doc. Consider validating top-level section keys against an allow-list before upsert.

/api/admin/upload writes directly to disk under /app/backend/uploads — on container restart in some envs this dir is ephemeral. Also no size limit (UploadFile.read is not gated); add `Content-Length` check or stream-with-limit to prevent disk fill.
JWT_SECRET committed in /app/backend/.env — fine for preview but rotate before prod and ensure .env is gitignored.
verify_password swallows all exceptions and returns False silently — fine for security, but log the cause once at debug level for misformatted hashes diagnostics.
AdminDashboard.ContactsList nested <button> issue (above) — also from a11y standpoint screen-readers will skip the inner controls.

Run via: cd /app && pytest backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Admin endpoints all require Bearer token from POST /api/auth/login. Hot reload works on both services; no .env changes required for retest.
rca of the issue: Nested-button hydration warning RCA: AdminDashboard.ContactsList line 525 wraps the entire contact card in `<button onClick={toggle}>` to make it clickable; inside it, line 540 has `<a href='mailto:'>` and line 547 has `<button onClick={delete}>`. HTML spec forbids interactive descendants of <button>. Fix: replace the outer <button> with `<div role='button' tabIndex={0} onClick={toggle} onKeyDown={enterToggle}>` — preserves UX, removes nesting, also fixes screen-reader navigation.
